name: vela
description: Draft training programmes straight into your Vela coaching account.
long_description:
Lets Claude read your exercise library, check a programme draft against it, and create the programme in your Vela account. It never assigns a programme to a client — that stays a deliberate step you take in the portal.

You need a personal API key: in Vela, open Settings → API keys, create one, and paste it here.
